title: Investment plan
empty: No investment plan set up yet.

meta.title: Investment plan
meta.description: Long-term goal, recorded contributions and portfolio drift against the target allocation.

emptyGuide: Set up your long-term goal: monthly contribution, horizon and allocation by company, sector or asset class. Once the plan is created, your contributions and your portfolio's drift against that goal will show here.

sections.goalDescription: Long-term goal, monthly contribution and target allocation
sections.positionsDescription: Companies with a target or current weight
sections.positionsEmpty: The plan has no per-ticker positions yet.
sections.driftDescription: Drift of the current portfolio against the target allocation
sections.contributionsDescription: History of contributions to the plan
sections.contributionsEmpty: You have not recorded any contributions to your plan yet.

planKeys.actual_contributions_base: Recorded contributions (only if all have an exchange rate)
planKeys.actual_contributions_converted_base: Converted contributions (partial if rates are missing)
planKeys.expected_contributions_converted_base: Expected contributions converted (partial if rates are missing)

values.statusEmptyPortfolio: Empty portfolio: nothing to rebalance yet
values.expectedMissingFx: {count} {unit} missing an exchange rate{pair} on or before their due date{range}

split.title: This month's contribution
split.fallbackDescription: Monthly contribution split by DCA level
split.basisObjetivosTicker: Target weights per ticker × DCA level
split.basisPosicionesIguales: Live positions in equal parts × DCA level
split.emptyNoPlan: Set up the plan to see the contribution split.
split.emptyNoCandidates: The plan has no per-ticker targets or live positions: there is nothing to split the contribution across.
split.weightNote: 4X weighs 4, 3X 3, 2X 2, 1X 1; trim zones get no new money and no DCA level weighs as 1X.

setup.title: Set up investment plan
setup.description: Monthly contribution, horizon and target allocation. Each category (tickers, sectors or asset classes) can add up to 100%.
setup.currencyLegacyNote: Currency not recorded: confirm which currency you made this contribution in.
setup.errorMonthly: The monthly contribution must be a number greater than 0.
setup.errorHorizon: The horizon must be a whole number between 1 and 80 years.
setup.errorAllocation: Each allocation needs a label and a percentage between 0 and 100.
setup.errorBand: The band must be between 0 and 50 percentage points.
setup.errorDuplicate: Do not repeat the same target within a category.
setup.overallocated: The {dimension} targets add up to {total}%: they cannot exceed 100% within that category.
setup.errorCurrencyChange: This plan has a recorded currency. To change the amount, update the app and choose the currency: nothing was saved.
setup.errorCurrencyUnavailable: The contribution currency is not available on the server yet: nothing was saved.

contribution.title: Record contribution
contribution.description: Record the money you have added to the plan. It tracks whether you are keeping up with your instalment; it does not place any order.
contribution.errorDateFuture: The date cannot be in the future: record the contribution when you make it.
contribution.errorAmountMin: The amount must be greater than 0 (minimum 0.01).
contribution.saveFailed: The contribution could not be saved. Check the date, amount and currency.

deleteContribution.confirmDescription: Only this plan record is deleted. Your portfolio and transactions are untouched.
